out.title: V.N. Srivatsan appointed Chief Compliance Officer, effective January 4, 2027
out.summary: Rakesh Kumar Rajput's 3-year term as Chief Compliance Officer ended September 30, 2026. V.N. Srivatsan (from ICICI Bank) appointed for 3 years from January 4, 2027; Venkateswaran L interim CCO.

person.name: V. N. Srivatsan
person.bio: ~34 years' experience, ~25 in BFSI, ~10 in compliance; currently Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank; PG in Business Administration, B.Tech.
